name: Do I need a general contractor for built-in shelving installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a general contractor for built-in shelving installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For complex or larger built-in shelving projects, especially those requiring structural modifications, electrical work for integrated lighting, or coordination with other trades, hiring a general contractor is highly recommended. A general contractor, like City Dweller, LLC, manages the entire project from design to completion, ensuring all aspects are coordinated smoothly, permits are obtained if necessary, and the work meets quality and safety standards. For simpler, non-structural installations, a specialized cabinet maker or carpenter might suffice, but a general contractor provides comprehensive oversight.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor is recommended for complex built-in shelving projects involving structural changes or multiple trades, ensuring comprehensive project management.
